title: Introducing Octoweb: A Keyboard-First Browser Where the AI Is a Citizen, Not an Extension
excerpt: Octoweb is a WebKit browser written in Rust for people who live on the keyboard — command palette, fast-access slots, readline bindings everywhere. And it treats AI as a first-class citizen in both directions: an Octomind-powered agent in the sidebar you can even code with, and a token-efficient MCP server inside the browser so your agents can drive it. We built it for ourselves; five months in, it is our daily browser. macOS, open source, Apache-2.0.
content_html:
Every browser suddenly has AI in it. And every one of them did it the same way: take Chrome, bolt a chat panel onto the side, call it an AI browser. The browser doesn't know the agent exists. The agent can't touch the browser. Two strangers sharing a window.

We spent this year building agents — a runtime, memory, code search, a filesystem layer — and at some point the question became unavoidable: what would a browser look like if it were designed for AI from the first commit? Not AI added. AI as a citizen — in both directions. The agent lives in the browser and can see what you see. And the browser is a tool the agent can pick up and use.

So we built it — for ourselves, the way you build a tool you intend to live in. Octoweb is a WebKit browser written in Rust — no Electron, no Chromium, about 25,000 lines — made for two overlapping audiences: people who live on the keyboard, and people who work with agents all day. We're both, and five months later it's the browser we start every morning in: reading docs, debugging our own web apps, handing the boring browser chores to Octomind while we keep reading. Today it hits 0.10.0, and it's time to tell you about it.

First, the geek part: no mouse required

Before the AI does anything, Octoweb has to earn its place as a browser for people who think in keystrokes. The design rule was simple: every action has a shortcut, nothing requires a click.

The center of it is the command palette (⌘⇧P) — type a URL, a search query, or any fragment of a page you've visited, and it fuzzy-matches across open tabs and history, ranked by match quality and visit frequency. One more keystroke opens, switches, or searches. And because muscle memory is sacred, the palette speaks readline: ⌃A/⌃E to jump, ⌃K/⌃U to kill, ⌃N/⌃P to move. If your fingers know Emacs or a shell, they already know Octoweb.

The rest of the vocabulary:

  • Fast-access slots — ⌘⇧1–⌘⇧0 pins the current page to a numbered slot; ⌘1–⌘0 jumps back from anywhere. Ten pages, one keystroke each, persisted across restarts. It's the browser equivalent of Vim marks. New in 0.10.0: ⌘⇧N pins the current page to the first free slot — and unpins it if it's already there.
  • MRU tab cycling — ⌃N/⌃P walks tabs in most-recently-used order, the way you actually switch between two pages, not the order they happen to sit in the tab bar.
  • Vim-style scrolling — ⌃D/⌃U for half pages, ⌃T/⌃B for top and bottom.
  • Screenshots to clipboard — ⌘S viewport, ⌘⇧S full page. No save dialog, no file to clean up later.
  • ⌃R in the AI prompt box — reverse incremental search through your prompt history. Yes: we put readline's history search in the browser's AI input, because once you've had it in a shell you want it everywhere.

Global shortcuts run through CGEventTap, macOS-native and configurable. And this is why Octoweb is macOS-only for now — it leans on the platform (WKWebView, AppKit, CGEventTap) instead of shipping a second operating system in a zip file. That's also why the whole browser is a single lean binary instead of a 300 MB Electron app.

The agent in the sidebar — running on Octomind

Press ⌘⇧A and an agent slides in over the page. Not an iframe with a chat website in it — a real agent process, running locally, connected over the Agent Client Protocol.

The agent is Octomind, our plug-and-play agent runtime — the same one that powers our terminal sessions and CI reviews. And here's the part you don't do: start it. Octoweb launches octomind acp octoweb:assistant itself — a sandboxed subprocess per session, restarted if it dies, resumed with your conversation intact on the next launch. Install Octomind once, and the sidebar takes it from there.

That octoweb:assistant tag is a manifest from the community tap registry: model, system prompt, and tools, fetched and assembled automatically. Zero config files written by hand. From then on you can ask about the page you're reading, get code on it explained, or summarize a thread you don't have time for — with responses streaming in, sessions that persist and resume, and slash commands with rich output cards.

And because it's a real agent, the sidebar isn't a chat box with opinions — it works. Swap the tag to developer:rust and you can code from the browser: the agent edits files in its sandboxed workspace, tool calls show up as clickable rows with live status, and when it wants to show you something richer than prose — a form, a table, a small interactive UI — it renders an A2UI surface right in the sidebar. We've fixed bugs in Octoweb, from Octoweb, while the failing page sat in the next tab.

Three details we sweated:

  • The agent tag is editable. The sidebar header shows octoweb:assistant by default, but type any tag your Octomind knows — developer:rust, your own custom agent — and the sidebar reconnects to it on the spot. The browser doesn't care which brain it's talking to.
  • The browser never calls an AI provider. Every model call is made by Octomind, outside the browser process, with the agent's filesystem access sandboxed to its workspace. No data leaves your machine unless your agent sends it somewhere — and which agent that is, with which provider, is entirely your call.
  • The session is a two-way street. Since 0.10.0, messages injected by the Octomind runtime — a specialist replying from the tap, a scheduled job finishing, a webhook firing — arrive in the sidebar as their own labeled bubbles, mid-conversation. Your browser becomes the place where your agents report back.

There's also a smaller door: select text on any page, press ⌘⇧E, and an inline edit modal transforms the selection — rewrite, summarize, translate. It runs its own dedicated agent from the same tap — octoweb:editor — with its own prompt history, ⌃R and all.

The browser as a tool: MCP from the inside

This is the direction nobody else builds, and it's our favorite part. Octoweb runs an MCP server inside the browser — localhost:3434/mcp. Any MCP client — Claude Desktop, an Octomind session, your own script — can connect and drive it: twenty-six tools covering navigation, tabs, clicking, typing, scrolling, screenshots, content extraction, console output, and network activity.

You've seen browser automation before. The difference here is that the agent isn't driving a headless Chromium in a datacenter with no cookies and a bot-detection target on its back. It's driving your browser — your sessions, your logins, your tabs — while you watch. And the tool design takes "while you watch" seriously:

  • Navigation never steals focus. browser_navigate always opens in the background. Exactly one tool — browser_switch_tab — is allowed to change what you're looking at. An agent can research in ten tabs behind your back without ever yanking the page out from under your cursor. It browses beside you, not instead of you.
  • Clicks that don't lie. browser_click retries until the element is present, stable, and unobstructed — and if something is covering it, the error says what. browser_snapshot returns a map of interactive elements with stable @N refs that pierces iframes, shadow DOM, and listener-only clickables. browser_wait knows about SPA readiness, not just page load.
  • Eyes included. browser_console_messages and browser_network_requests give the agent the page's console errors and fetch/XHR activity with statuses and timings — the two things you'd open DevTools for, as tools.
  • Guard rails at the boundary. Text that flows out through snapshots and page content passes a sanitizer — card numbers get redacted before they ever reach a prompt.
  • Tokens are the budget. Every tool answer is shaped for a model, not for a debugger: browser_snapshot returns a compact element map instead of raw HTML (we deleted the get_html tool on purpose), console and network logs come capped and filterable, and @N refs mean the agent never burns half a context window guessing CSS selectors. An agent's turn is priced in tokens; the browser respects that.

And if your agent runtime is Octomind, wiring it up is one line inside a session:

/mcp add octoweb http://localhost:3434/mcp

The agent you were already talking to can now open docs, read them, fill forms, and check what a page's console is screaming about — mid-conversation, no restart. This is how browser chores leave our to-do lists: the agent reproduces a bug in a background tab, reads the console, and comes back with the failing request; it walks an admin panel we didn't feel like clicking through; it checks that a deploy actually rendered — in our logged-in browser, with our sessions, while we keep reading in the foreground tab.

The browser that learns with you

One more experiment: proactive learning. On an interval — 30 minutes by default — Octoweb wakes a second, fully independent agent, the octoweb:learning tag, which looks at your open tabs and recent history and distills what you're working on into Octomind's memory. Next session, the sidebar assistant already knows the docs you've been circling for three days.

It's on by default — one toggle in Settings turns it off — it's local, the interval is yours to set, and the two agents are fully independent: run either without the other. We think ambient memory is where browser AI actually gets interesting, and we'd rather ship the honest v1 of it than a demo.

Yes, it's also just a good browser

None of this matters if the browsing is worse than what you left. The fundamentals are there, and a few are better than there:

  • Smart tab hibernation — background tabs freeze under memory pressure, with RAM-aware thresholds. Fifty tabs is a lifestyle, not a leak. And since 0.10.0 there's a cap on open tabs (500 by default, configurable) that quietly closes the least-recently-used ones past it — an airbag for tab hoarders.
  • Content blocking built in — trackers and ads via WebKit's native content rule lists, no extension needed.
  • Cold starts stay cold — favicons are cached as data-URIs, so launching the browser makes zero network requests until you do.
  • Session restore, WebAuthn passkeys, PDF and DOCX viewing, find-in-page on the CSS Custom Highlight API, native fullscreen, proper popup-window handling.

What about extensions? Honest status: the Safari Web Extensions integration (for 1Password, Bitwarden, and friends) is fully implemented in the code — and blocked on Apple's com.apple.developer.web-browser entitlement, an approval only Apple can grant. Until it lands, content scripts don't inject. We'd rather tell you that than pretend extensions are a roadmap item.

Five months, 0.1.0 to 0.10.0

Octoweb started in late March as an experiment: could a keyboard browser with an ACP sidebar be usable in a week? By 0.6.0 it had tab hibernation and the first MCP automation tools. 0.7.0 brought persistent chat sessions, passkeys, and slash commands. 0.8.0 was the big one — the actionability harness, the e2e suite that tests the browser through its own MCP server, agent sandboxing, configurable keybindings, A2UI surfaces. 0.9.0, cut in late July, moved to ACP v1.2.0 with account authentication and a long tail of stability work. And today's 0.10.0 is what daily use does to a roadmap: pinned tabs, the open-tab cap, account quota status that refreshes itself, specialist messages landing in the sidebar — plus fixes for a memory leak and orphaned agent processes, the kind of thing you only find by leaving it running for weeks.

What started as an experiment is now the browser we actually live in. It won't replace your main browser this year — it might become the one you reach for when you want to think.

Get it

One line on any Mac, Apple Silicon or Intel:

brew install --cask muvon/tap/octoweb

Or grab a prebuilt archive from GitHub Releases, or build from source with a Rust toolchain:

git clone https://github.com/muvon/octoweb
cd octoweb
./build.sh --dev        # ad-hoc signed, no cert needed
open dist/Octoweb.app

For the sidebar, install Octomind and sign in:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/muvon/octomind/master/install.sh | bash
octomind login

octomind login is a device-code sign-in to Octomind Cloud — the subscription includes model access, so there's nothing else to configure, and the sidebar shows your account and quota status. Prefer your own keys? Skip the login and export any provider key instead (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, …) — BYOK is a first-class path. Either way, that's the whole setup: launch Octoweb, press ⌘⇧A, and say hello — the browser starts and manages the agent process itself. Config is one TOML file at ~/Library/Application Support/octoweb/config.toml; Settings is ⌘,.

Octoweb is on GitHub under Apache-2.0, like everything else we ship. If you live on the keyboard, or your agents deserve a real browser instead of a headless one — try it, and tell us what's missing. The features requested by early users are the reason 0.10.0 looks nothing like 0.1.0.

— Don

blocks.html_en: First, the geek part: no mouse required

sentences.en: First, the geek part: no mouse required
sentences.zh: 一、极客部分：不需要鼠标

blocks.html_en: Before the AI does anything, Octoweb has to earn its place as a browser for people who think in keystrokes. The design rule was simple: every action has a shortcut, nothing requires a click.

sentences.en: Before the AI does anything, Octoweb has to earn its place as a browser for people who think in keystrokes.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能做任何事情之前，Octoweb 必须赢得自己作为浏览器的地位，为那些通过击键思考的人提供浏览器。

sentences.en: The design rule was simple: every action has a shortcut, nothing requires a click.
sentences.zh: 设计规则很简单：每个操作都有一个快捷方式，不需要单击。

blocks.html_en: The center of it is the command palette (⌘⇧P) — type a URL, a search query, or any fragment of a page you've visited, and it fuzzy-matches across open tabs and history, ranked by match quality and visit frequency. One more keystroke opens, switches, or searches. And because muscle memory is sacred, the palette speaks readline: ⌃A/⌃E to jump, ⌃K/⌃U to kill, ⌃N/⌃P to move. If your fingers know Emacs or a shell, they already know Octoweb.

sentences.en: The center of it is the command palette (⌘⇧P) — type a URL, a search query, or any fragment of a page you've visited, and it fuzzy-matches across open tabs and history, ranked by match quality and visit frequency.
sentences.zh: 它的中心是命令面板 (⌘⇧P) — 输入 URL、搜索查询或您访问过的页面的任何片段，它会在打开的选项卡和历史记录中进行模糊匹配，并按匹配质量和访问频率进行排名。

sentences.en: One more keystroke opens, switches, or searches.
sentences.zh: 再按一次键即可打开、切换或搜索。

sentences.en: And because muscle memory is sacred, the palette speaks readline: ⌃A/⌃E to jump, ⌃K/⌃U to kill, ⌃N/⌃P to move.
sentences.zh: 因为肌肉记忆是神圣的，所以调色板会说出读线：⌃A/⌃E 跳跃，⌃K/⌃U 杀死，⌃N/⌃P 移动。

sentences.en: If your fingers know Emacs or a shell, they already know Octoweb.
sentences.zh: 如果您的手指了解 Emacs 或 shell，那么他们就已经了解 Octoweb。

blocks.html_en: The rest of the vocabulary:

sentences.en: The rest of the vocabulary:
sentences.zh: 其余词汇：

blocks.html_en: • Fast-access slots — ⌘⇧1–⌘⇧0 pins the current page to a numbered slot; ⌘1–⌘0 jumps back from anywhere. Ten pages, one keystroke each, persisted across restarts. It's the browser equivalent of Vim marks. New in 0.10.0: ⌘⇧N pins the current page to the first free slot — and unpins it if it's already there.

sentences.en: Fast-access slots — ⌘⇧1–⌘⇧0 pins the current page to a numbered slot; ⌘1–⌘0 jumps back from anywhere.
sentences.zh: 快速访问插槽 — ⌘⇧1–⌘⇧0 将当前页面固定到编号插槽； ⌘1–⌘0 从任意位置跳回。

sentences.en: Ten pages, one keystroke each, persisted across restarts.
sentences.zh: 十页，每页一次击键，在重新启动后仍然存在。

sentences.en: It's the browser equivalent of Vim marks.
sentences.zh: 它在浏览器中相当于 Vim 标记。

sentences.en: New in 0.10.0: ⌘⇧N pins the current page to the first free slot — and unpins it if it's already there.
sentences.zh: 0.10.0 中的新增功能： ⌘⇧N 将当前页面固定到第一个空闲插槽 - 如果它已经存在，则将其取消固定。

blocks.html_en: • MRU tab cycling — ⌃N/⌃P walks tabs in most-recently-used order, the way you actually switch between two pages, not the order they happen to sit in the tab bar.

sentences.en: MRU tab cycling — ⌃N/⌃P walks tabs in most-recently-used order, the way you actually switch between two pages, not the order they happen to sit in the tab bar.
sentences.zh: MRU 选项卡循环 — ⌃N/⌃P 按最近使用的顺序遍历选项卡，这是您在两个页面之间实际切换的方式，而不是它们恰好位于选项卡栏中的顺序。

blocks.html_en: • Vim-style scrolling — ⌃D/⌃U for half pages, ⌃T/⌃B for top and bottom.

sentences.en: Vim-style scrolling — ⌃D/⌃U for half pages, ⌃T/⌃B for top and bottom.
sentences.zh: Vim 风格的滚动 — ⌃D/⌃U 表示半页，⌃T/⌃B 表示顶部和底部。

blocks.html_en: • Screenshots to clipboard — ⌘S viewport, ⌘⇧S full page. No save dialog, no file to clean up later.

sentences.en: Screenshots to clipboard — ⌘S viewport, ⌘⇧S full page.
sentences.zh: 屏幕截图到剪贴板 — ⌘S 视口，⌘⇧S 整页。

sentences.en: No save dialog, no file to clean up later.
sentences.zh: 没有保存对话框，没有文件可供稍后清理。

blocks.html_en: • ⌃R in the AI prompt box — reverse incremental search through your prompt history. Yes: we put readline's history search in the browser's AI input, because once you've had it in a shell you want it everywhere.

sentences.en: ⌃R in the AI prompt box — reverse incremental search through your prompt history.
sentences.zh: AI 提示框中的 ⌃R — 通过提示历史记录反向增量搜索。

sentences.en: Yes: we put readline's history search in the browser's AI input, because once you've had it in a shell you want it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 是的：我们将 readline 的历史搜索放入浏览器的 AI 输入中，因为一旦您将其放入 shell 中，您就希望它随处可见。

blocks.html_en: Global shortcuts run through CGEventTap, macOS-native and configurable. And this is why Octoweb is macOS-only for now — it leans on the platform (WKWebView, AppKit, CGEventTap) instead of shipping a second operating system in a zip file. That's also why the whole browser is a single lean binary instead of a 300 MB Electron app.

sentences.en: Global shortcuts run through CGEventTap, macOS-native and configurable.
sentences.zh: 全局快捷方式通过 CGEventTap 运行，macOS 原生且可配置。

sentences.en: And this is why Octoweb is macOS-only for now — it leans on the platform (WKWebView, AppKit, CGEventTap) instead of shipping a second operating system in a zip file.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么 Octoweb 目前仅适用于 macOS - 它依赖于平台（WKWebView、AppKit、CGEventTap），而不是在 zip 文件中提供第二个操作系统。

sentences.en: That's also why the whole browser is a single lean binary instead of a 300 MB Electron app.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么整个浏览器是一个精简的二进制文件而不是 300 MB Electron 应用程序。

blocks.html_en: The agent in the sidebar — running on Octomind

sentences.en: The agent in the sidebar — running on Octomind
sentences.zh: 侧边栏中的代理 — 在 Octomind 上运行

blocks.html_en: Press ⌘⇧A and an agent slides in over the page. Not an iframe with a chat website in it — a real agent process, running locally, connected over the Agent Client Protocol.

sentences.en: Press ⌘⇧A and an agent slides in over the page.
sentences.zh: 按 ⌘⇧A，代理就会滑入页面。

sentences.en: Not an iframe with a chat website in it — a real agent process, running locally, connected over the Agent Client Protocol.
sentences.zh: 不是一个带有聊天网站的 iframe——一个真正的代理进程，在本地运行，通过代理客户端协议连接。

blocks.html_en: The agent is Octomind, our plug-and-play agent runtime — the same one that powers our terminal sessions and CI reviews. And here's the part you don't do: start it. Octoweb launches octomind acp octoweb:assistant itself — a sandboxed subprocess per session, restarted if it dies, resumed with your conversation intact on the next launch. Install Octomind once, and the sidebar takes it from there.

sentences.en: The agent is Octomind, our plug-and-play agent runtime — the same one that powers our terminal sessions and CI reviews.
sentences.zh: 该代理是 Octomind，我们的即插即用代理运行时 - 与为我们的终端会话和 CI 审查提供支持的运行时相同。

sentences.en: And here's the part you don't do: start it.
sentences.zh: 这是你不需要做的部分：启动它。

sentences.en: Octoweb launches octomind acp octoweb:assistant itself — a sandboxed subprocess per session, restarted if it dies, resumed with your conversation intact on the next launch.
sentences.zh: Octoweb 启动 octomind acp octoweb:assistant 本身 - 每个会话的沙盒子进程，如果它死掉则重新启动，并在下次启动时恢复完整的对话。

sentences.en: Install Octomind once, and the sidebar takes it from there.
sentences.zh: 安装 Octomind 一次，侧边栏就会从那里获取它。

blocks.html_en: That octoweb:assistant tag is a manifest from the community tap registry: model, system prompt, and tools, fetched and assembled automatically. Zero config files written by hand. From then on you can ask about the page you're reading, get code on it explained, or summarize a thread you don't have time for — with responses streaming in, sessions that persist and resume, and slash commands with rich output cards.

sentences.en: That octoweb:assistant tag is a manifest from the community tap registry: model, system prompt, and tools, fetched and assembled automatically.
sentences.zh: 该 octoweb:assistant 标签是来自社区 Tap 注册表的清单：模型、系统提示和工具，自动获取和组装。

sentences.en: Zero config files written by hand.
sentences.zh: 手工编写的零配置文件。

sentences.en: From then on you can ask about the page you're reading, get code on it explained, or summarize a thread you don't have time for — with responses streaming in, sessions that persist and resume, and slash commands with rich output cards.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，您可以询问您正在阅读的页面，解释其中的代码，或者总结您没有时间的线程 - 响应不断涌入，持续和恢复的会话以及具有丰富输出卡的斜杠命令。

blocks.html_en: And because it's a real agent, the sidebar isn't a chat box with opinions — it works. Swap the tag to developer:rust and you can code from the browser: the agent edits files in its sandboxed workspace, tool calls show up as clickable rows with live status, and when it wants to show you something richer than prose — a form, a table, a small interactive UI — it renders an A2UI surface right in the sidebar. We've fixed bugs in Octoweb, from Octoweb, while the failing page sat in the next tab.

sentences.en: And because it's a real agent, the sidebar isn't a chat box with opinions — it works.
sentences.zh: 而且因为它是一个真正的代理，所以侧边栏不是一个带有意见的聊天框 - 它有效。

sentences.en: Swap the tag to developer:rust and you can code from the browser: the agent edits files in its sandboxed workspace, tool calls show up as clickable rows with live status, and when it wants to show you something richer than prose — a form, a table, a small interactive UI — it renders an A2UI surface right in the sidebar.
sentences.zh: 将标签替换为developer:rust，您就可以从浏览器中进行编码：代理在其沙盒工作区中编辑文件，工具调用显示为具有实时状态的可点击行，当它想要向您展示比散文更丰富的内容时（表单、表格、小型交互式 UI），它会在侧边栏中呈现一个 A2UI 表面。

sentences.en: We've fixed bugs in Octoweb, from Octoweb, while the failing page sat in the next tab.
sentences.zh: 我们修复了 Octoweb 中的错误，而失败的页面位于下一个选项卡中。

blocks.html_en: Three details we sweated:

sentences.en: Three details we sweated:
sentences.zh: 我们精心设计的三个细节：

blocks.html_en: • The agent tag is editable. The sidebar header shows octoweb:assistant by default, but type any tag your Octomind knows — developer:rust, your own custom agent — and the sidebar reconnects to it on the spot. The browser doesn't care which brain it's talking to.

sentences.en: The agent tag is editable.
sentences.zh: 代理标签是可编辑的。

sentences.en: The sidebar header shows octoweb:assistant by default, but type any tag your Octomind knows — developer:rust, your own custom agent — and the sidebar reconnects to it on the spot.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，侧边栏标题显示 octoweb:assistant，但输入您的 Octomind 知道的任何标签（developer:rust、您自己的自定义代理），侧边栏就会立即重新连接到它。

sentences.en: The browser doesn't care which brain it's talking to.
sentences.zh: 浏览器并不关心它正在与哪个大脑对话。

blocks.html_en: • The browser never calls an AI provider. Every model call is made by Octomind, outside the browser process, with the agent's filesystem access sandboxed to its workspace. No data leaves your machine unless your agent sends it somewhere — and which agent that is, with which provider, is entirely your call.

sentences.en: The browser never calls an AI provider.
sentences.zh: 浏览器从不调用人工智能提供商。

sentences.en: Every model call is made by Octomind, outside the browser process, with the agent's filesystem access sandboxed to its workspace.
sentences.zh: 每个模型调用都是由 Octomind 在浏览器进程之外进行，代理的文件系统访问沙箱到其工作区。

sentences.en: No data leaves your machine unless your agent sends it somewhere — and which agent that is, with which provider, is entirely your call.
sentences.zh: 除非您的代理将其发送到某个地方，否则数据不会离开您的机器 - 而哪个代理、哪个提供商完全由您决定。

blocks.html_en: • The session is a two-way street. Since 0.10.0, messages injected by the Octomind runtime — a specialist replying from the tap, a scheduled job finishing, a webhook firing — arrive in the sidebar as their own labeled bubbles, mid-conversation. Your browser becomes the place where your agents report back.

sentences.en: The session is a two-way street.
sentences.zh: 本次会议是双向的。

sentences.en: Since 0.10.0, messages injected by the Octomind runtime — a specialist replying from the tap, a scheduled job finishing, a webhook firing — arrive in the sidebar as their own labeled bubbles, mid-conversation.
sentences.zh: 从 0.10.0 开始，Octomind 运行时注入的消息（专家从水龙头回复、计划的作业完成、Webhook 触发）在对话过程中以自己标记的气泡形式到达侧边栏。

sentences.en: Your browser becomes the place where your agents report back.
sentences.zh: 您的浏览器将成为您的代理进行报告的地方。

blocks.html_en: There's also a smaller door: select text on any page, press ⌘⇧E, and an inline edit modal transforms the selection — rewrite, summarize, translate. It runs its own dedicated agent from the same tap — octoweb:editor — with its own prompt history, ⌃R and all.

sentences.en: There's also a smaller door: select text on any page, press ⌘⇧E, and an inline edit modal transforms the selection — rewrite, summarize, translate.
sentences.zh: 还有一扇较小的门：在任何页面上选择文本，按 ⌘⇧E，内联编辑模式会转换选择 — 重写、总结、翻译。

sentences.en: It runs its own dedicated agent from the same tap — octoweb:editor — with its own prompt history, ⌃R and all.
sentences.zh: 它通过同一个水龙头（octoweb:editor）运行自己的专用代理，并具有自己的提示历史记录、⌃R 等。

blocks.html_en: The browser as a tool: MCP from the inside

sentences.en: The browser as a tool: MCP from the inside
sentences.zh: 浏览器作为工具：来自内部的 MCP

blocks.html_en: This is the direction nobody else builds, and it's our favorite part. Octoweb runs an MCP server inside the browser — localhost:3434/mcp. Any MCP client — Claude Desktop, an Octomind session, your own script — can connect and drive it: twenty-six tools covering navigation, tabs, clicking, typing, scrolling, screenshots, content extraction, console output, and network activity.

sentences.en: This is the direction nobody else builds, and it's our favorite part.
sentences.zh: 这是没有其他人构建的方向，也是我们最喜欢的部分。

sentences.en: Octoweb runs an MCP server inside the browser — localhost:3434/mcp.
sentences.zh: Octoweb 在浏览器内运行 MCP 服务器 — localhost:3434/mcp。

sentences.en: Any MCP client — Claude Desktop, an Octomind session, your own script — can connect and drive it: twenty-six tools covering navigation, tabs, clicking, typing, scrolling, screenshots, content extraction, console output, and network activity.
sentences.zh: 任何 MCP 客户端（Claude Desktop、Octomind 会话、您自己的脚本）都可以连接并驱动它：二十六个工具，涵盖导航、选项卡、单击、键入、滚动、屏幕截图、内容提取、控制台输出和网络活动。

blocks.html_en: You've seen browser automation before. The difference here is that the agent isn't driving a headless Chromium in a datacenter with no cookies and a bot-detection target on its back. It's driving your browser — your sessions, your logins, your tabs — while you watch. And the tool design takes "while you watch" seriously:

sentences.en: You've seen browser automation before.
sentences.zh: 您以前见过浏览器自动化。

sentences.en: The difference here is that the agent isn't driving a headless Chromium in a datacenter with no cookies and a bot-detection target on its back.
sentences.zh: 这里的区别在于，代理并不是在数据中心中驱动无头 Chromium，其背面没有 cookie 且没有机器人检测目标。

sentences.en: It's driving your browser — your sessions, your logins, your tabs — while you watch.
sentences.zh: 当您观看时，它会驱动您的浏览器 - 您的会话、登录、选项卡。

sentences.en: And the tool design takes "while you watch" seriously:
sentences.zh: 工具设计非常重视“当你观看时”：

blocks.html_en: • Navigation never steals focus. browser_navigate always opens in the background. Exactly one tool — browser_switch_tab — is allowed to change what you're looking at. An agent can research in ten tabs behind your back without ever yanking the page out from under your cursor. It browses beside you, not instead of you.

sentences.en: Navigation never steals focus.
sentences.zh: 导航永远不会抢走焦点。

sentences.en: browser_navigate always opens in the background.
sentences.zh: browser_navigate 始终在后台打开。

sentences.en: Exactly one tool — browser_switch_tab — is allowed to change what you're looking at.
sentences.zh: 只有一个工具 - browser_switch_tab - 可以更改您正在查看的内容。

sentences.en: An agent can research in ten tabs behind your back without ever yanking the page out from under your cursor.
sentences.zh: 代理可以在您背后研究十个选项卡，而无需将页面从您的光标下拉出。

sentences.en: It browses beside you, not instead of you.
sentences.zh: 它会在您旁边浏览，而不是代替您。

blocks.html_en: • Clicks that don't lie. browser_click retries until the element is present, stable, and unobstructed — and if something is covering it, the error says what. browser_snapshot returns a map of interactive elements with stable @N refs that pierces iframes, shadow DOM, and listener-only clickables. browser_wait knows about SPA readiness, not just page load.

sentences.en: Clicks that don't lie.
sentences.zh: 不会说谎的点击。

sentences.en: browser_click retries until the element is present, stable, and unobstructed — and if something is covering it, the error says what.
sentences.zh: browser_click 会重试，直到该元素存在、稳定且畅通无阻 - 如果有东西覆盖它，错误会说明是什么。

sentences.en: browser_snapshot returns a map of interactive elements with stable @N refs that pierces iframes, shadow DOM, and listener-only clickables.
sentences.zh: browser_snapshot 返回具有稳定 @N 引用的交互式元素的映射，该引用可穿透 iframe、shadow DOM 和仅侦听器可点击内容。

sentences.en: browser_wait knows about SPA readiness, not just page load.
sentences.zh: browser_wait 了解 SPA 准备情况，而不仅仅是页面加载。

blocks.html_en: • Eyes included. browser_console_messages and browser_network_requests give the agent the page's console errors and fetch/XHR activity with statuses and timings — the two things you'd open DevTools for, as tools.

sentences.en: Eyes included.
sentences.zh: 包括眼睛。

sentences.en: browser_console_messages and browser_network_requests give the agent the page's console errors and fetch/XHR activity with statuses and timings — the two things you'd open DevTools for, as tools.
sentences.zh: browser_console_messages 和 browser_network_requests 向代理提供页面的控制台错误和带有状态和计时的 fetch/XHR 活动 - 您将 DevTools 作为工具打开的两件事。

blocks.html_en: • Guard rails at the boundary. Text that flows out through snapshots and page content passes a sanitizer — card numbers get redacted before they ever reach a prompt.

sentences.en: Guard rails at the boundary.
sentences.zh: 边界处设有护栏。

sentences.en: Text that flows out through snapshots and page content passes a sanitizer — card numbers get redacted before they ever reach a prompt.
sentences.zh: 通过快照和页面内容流出的文本会经过消毒剂——卡号在到达提示之前就被编辑了。

blocks.html_en: • Tokens are the budget. Every tool answer is shaped for a model, not for a debugger: browser_snapshot returns a compact element map instead of raw HTML (we deleted the get_html tool on purpose), console and network logs come capped and filterable, and @N refs mean the agent never burns half a context window guessing CSS selectors. An agent's turn is priced in tokens; the browser respects that.

sentences.en: Tokens are the budget.
sentences.zh: 代币是预算。

sentences.en: Every tool answer is shaped for a model, not for a debugger: browser_snapshot returns a compact element map instead of raw HTML (we deleted the get_html tool on purpose), console and network logs come capped and filterable, and @N refs mean the agent never burns half a context window guessing CSS selectors.
sentences.zh: 每个工具的答案都是为模型设计的，而不是为调试器设计的：browser_snapshot 返回紧凑的元素映射而不是原始 HTML（我们故意删除了 get_html 工具），控制台和网络日志受到限制且可过滤，@N refs 意味着代理永远不会消耗半个上下文窗口来猜测 CSS 选择器。

sentences.en: An agent's turn is priced in tokens; the browser respects that.
sentences.zh: 代理人的轮次以代币定价；浏览器尊重这一点。

blocks.html_en: And if your agent runtime is Octomind, wiring it up is one line inside a session:

sentences.en: And if your agent runtime is Octomind, wiring it up is one line inside a session:
sentences.zh: 如果您的代理运行时是 Octomind，则只需会话中的一行即可将其连接起来：

blocks.html_en: The agent you were already talking to can now open docs, read them, fill forms, and check what a page's console is screaming about — mid-conversation, no restart. This is how browser chores leave our to-do lists: the agent reproduces a bug in a background tab, reads the console, and comes back with the failing request; it walks an admin panel we didn't feel like clicking through; it checks that a deploy actually rendered — in our logged-in browser, with our sessions, while we keep reading in the foreground tab.

sentences.en: The agent you were already talking to can now open docs, read them, fill forms, and check what a page's console is screaming about — mid-conversation, no restart.

content_html_zh:
每个浏览器突然都融入了人工智能。 他们每个人都以同样的方式做到了：拿 Chrome，在侧面安装一个聊天面板，称之为人工智能浏览器。 浏览器不知道代理存在。 代理无法接触浏览器。 两个陌生人共用一个窗户。

我们花了今年的时间构建代理——运行时、内存、代码搜索、文件系统层——在某些时候，这个问题变得不可避免：如果浏览器从第一次提交时就为人工智能设计，它会是什么样子？ 没有添加AI。 人工智能作为公民——双向。 代理位于浏览器中，可以看到您所看到的内容。 浏览器是代理可以拿起和使用的工具。

所以我们为我们自己构建了它，就像你构建一个你想要使用的工具一样。 Octoweb 是一款用 Rust 编写的 WebKit 浏览器（没有 Electron，没有 Chromium，大约 25,000 行），面向两个重叠的受众：靠键盘生活的人，以及整天与代理一起工作的人。 我们都是，五个月后，它成为我们每天早上启动的浏览器：阅读文档，调试我们自己的网络应用程序，在我们继续阅读的同时将无聊的浏览器琐事交给 Octomind。 今天它达到了 0.10.0，是时候向您介绍它了。

一、极客部分：不需要鼠标

在人工智能做任何事情之前，Octoweb 必须赢得自己作为浏览器的地位，为那些通过击键思考的人提供浏览器。 设计规则很简单：每个操作都有一个快捷方式，不需要单击。

它的中心是命令面板 (⌘⇧P) — 输入 URL、搜索查询或您访问过的页面的任何片段，它会在打开的选项卡和历史记录中进行模糊匹配，并按匹配质量和访问频率进行排名。 再按一次键即可打开、切换或搜索。 因为肌肉记忆是神圣的，所以调色板会说出读线：⌃A/⌃E 跳跃，⌃K/⌃U 杀死，⌃N/⌃P 移动。 如果您的手指了解 Emacs 或 shell，那么他们就已经了解 Octoweb。

其余词汇：

  • 快速访问插槽 — ⌘⇧1–⌘⇧0 将当前页面固定到编号插槽； ⌘1–⌘0 从任意位置跳回。 十页，每页一次击键，在重新启动后仍然存在。 它在浏览器中相当于 Vim 标记。 0.10.0 中的新增功能： ⌘⇧N 将当前页面固定到第一个空闲插槽 - 如果它已经存在，则将其取消固定。
  • MRU 选项卡循环 — ⌃N/⌃P 按最近使用的顺序遍历选项卡，这是您在两个页面之间实际切换的方式，而不是它们恰好位于选项卡栏中的顺序。
  • Vim 风格的滚动 — ⌃D/⌃U 表示半页，⌃T/⌃B 表示顶部和底部。
  • 屏幕截图到剪贴板 — ⌘S 视口，⌘⇧S 整页。 没有保存对话框，没有文件可供稍后清理。
  • AI 提示框中的 ⌃R — 通过提示历史记录反向增量搜索。 是的：我们将 readline 的历史搜索放入浏览器的 AI 输入中，因为一旦您将其放入 shell 中，您就希望它随处可见。

全局快捷方式通过 CGEventTap 运行，macOS 原生且可配置。 这就是为什么 Octoweb 目前仅适用于 macOS - 它依赖于平台（WKWebView、AppKit、CGEventTap），而不是在 zip 文件中提供第二个操作系统。 这也是为什么整个浏览器是一个精简的二进制文件而不是 300 MB Electron 应用程序。

侧边栏中的代理 — 在 Octomind 上运行

按 ⌘⇧A，代理就会滑入页面。 不是一个带有聊天网站的 iframe——一个真正的代理进程，在本地运行，通过代理客户端协议连接。

该代理是 Octomind，我们的即插即用代理运行时 - 与为我们的终端会话和 CI 审查提供支持的运行时相同。 这是你不需要做的部分：启动它。 Octoweb 启动 octomind acp octoweb:assistant 本身 - 每个会话的沙盒子进程，如果它死掉则重新启动，并在下次启动时恢复完整的对话。 安装 Octomind 一次，侧边栏就会从那里获取它。

该 octoweb:assistant 标签是来自社区 Tap 注册表的清单：模型、系统提示和工具，自动获取和组装。 手工编写的零配置文件。 从那时起，您可以询问您正在阅读的页面，解释其中的代码，或者总结您没有时间的线程 - 响应不断涌入，持续和恢复的会话以及具有丰富输出卡的斜杠命令。

而且因为它是一个真正的代理，所以侧边栏不是一个带有意见的聊天框 - 它有效。 将标签替换为developer:rust，您就可以从浏览器中进行编码：代理在其沙盒工作区中编辑文件，工具调用显示为具有实时状态的可点击行，当它想要向您展示比散文更丰富的内容时（表单、表格、小型交互式 UI），它会在侧边栏中呈现一个 A2UI 表面。 我们修复了 Octoweb 中的错误，而失败的页面位于下一个选项卡中。

我们精心设计的三个细节：

  • 代理标签是可编辑的。 默认情况下，侧边栏标题显示 octoweb:assistant，但输入您的 Octomind 知道的任何标签（developer:rust、您自己的自定义代理），侧边栏就会立即重新连接到它。 浏览器并不关心它正在与哪个大脑对话。
  • 浏览器从不调用人工智能提供商。 每个模型调用都是由 Octomind 在浏览器进程之外进行，代理的文件系统访问沙箱到其工作区。 除非您的代理将其发送到某个地方，否则数据不会离开您的机器 - 而哪个代理、哪个提供商完全由您决定。
  • 本次会议是双向的。 从 0.10.0 开始，Octomind 运行时注入的消息（专家从水龙头回复、计划的作业完成、Webhook 触发）在对话过程中以自己标记的气泡形式到达侧边栏。 您的浏览器将成为您的代理进行报告的地方。

还有一扇较小的门：在任何页面上选择文本，按 ⌘⇧E，内联编辑模式会转换选择 — 重写、总结、翻译。 它通过同一个水龙头（octoweb:editor）运行自己的专用代理，并具有自己的提示历史记录、⌃R 等。

浏览器作为工具：来自内部的 MCP

这是没有其他人构建的方向，也是我们最喜欢的部分。 Octoweb 在浏览器内运行 MCP 服务器 — localhost:3434/mcp。 任何 MCP 客户端（Claude Desktop、Octomind 会话、您自己的脚本）都可以连接并驱动它：二十六个工具，涵盖导航、选项卡、单击、键入、滚动、屏幕截图、内容提取、控制台输出和网络活动。

您以前见过浏览器自动化。 这里的区别在于，代理并不是在数据中心中驱动无头 Chromium，其背面没有 cookie 且没有机器人检测目标。 当您观看时，它会驱动您的浏览器 - 您的会话、登录、选项卡。 工具设计非常重视“当你观看时”：

  • 导航永远不会抢走焦点。 browser_navigate 始终在后台打开。 只有一个工具 - browser_switch_tab - 可以更改您正在查看的内容。 代理可以在您背后研究十个选项卡，而无需将页面从您的光标下拉出。 它会在您旁边浏览，而不是代替您。
  • 不会说谎的点击。 browser_click 会重试，直到该元素存在、稳定且畅通无阻 - 如果有东西覆盖它，错误会说明是什么。 browser_snapshot 返回具有稳定 @N 引用的交互式元素的映射，该引用可穿透 iframe、shadow DOM 和仅侦听器可点击内容。 browser_wait 了解 SPA 准备情况，而不仅仅是页面加载。
  • 包括眼睛。 browser_console_messages 和 browser_network_requests 向代理提供页面的控制台错误和带有状态和计时的 fetch/XHR 活动 - 您将 DevTools 作为工具打开的两件事。
  • 边界处设有护栏。 通过快照和页面内容流出的文本会经过消毒剂——卡号在到达提示之前就被编辑了。
  • 代币是预算。 每个工具的答案都是为模型设计的，而不是为调试器设计的：browser_snapshot 返回紧凑的元素映射而不是原始 HTML（我们故意删除了 get_html 工具），控制台和网络日志受到限制且可过滤，@N refs 意味着代理永远不会消耗半个上下文窗口来猜测 CSS 选择器。 代理人的轮次以代币定价；浏览器尊重这一点。

如果您的代理运行时是 Octomind，则只需会话中的一行即可将其连接起来：

/mcp add octoweb http://localhost:3434/mcp

您已经与之交谈的代理现在可以打开文档、阅读它们、填写表格，并检查页面控制台正在尖叫的内容——在对话中，无需重新启动。 这就是浏览器琐事离开我们的待办事项列表的方式：代理在后台选项卡中重现错误，读取控制台，然后返回失败的请求；它走过一个我们不想点击的管理面板；它检查部署是否在我们登录的浏览器中通过会话实际呈现，同时我们继续在前台选项卡中阅读。

与你一起学习的浏览器

另一项实验：主动学习。 每隔一段时间（默认为 30 分钟），Octoweb 会唤醒第二个完全独立的代理，即 octoweb:learning 标签，它会查看您打开的选项卡和最近的历史记录，并将您正在处理的内容提取到 Octomind 的内存中。 在下一个会话中，侧边栏助手已经知道您已经循环了三天的文档。

默认情况下它处于打开状态 - 设置中的一个切换将其关闭 - 它是本地的，间隔由您设置，并且两个代理完全独立：运行其中一个而无需另一个。 我们认为环境内存是浏览器人工智能真正变得有趣的地方，我们宁愿发布它的诚实 v1 而不是演示。

是的，它也是一个很好的浏览器

如果浏览的结果比你留下的更糟糕，那么这一切都无关紧要。 基本原理已经存在，并且有一些比那里更好：

  • 智能选项卡休眠 — 后台选项卡在内存压力下冻结，具有 RAM 感知阈值。 五十片是一种生活方式，而不是泄漏。 从 0.10.0 开始，打开的选项卡有一个上限（默认为 500 个，可配置），它会悄悄地关闭最近最少使用的选项卡——这是一个针对选项卡囤积者的安全气囊。
  • 内置内容拦截 - 通过 WebKit 的本机内容规则列表跟踪器和广告，无需扩展。
  • 冷启动保持冷状态 - 图标被缓存为数据 URI，因此启动浏览器会产生零网络请求，直到您启动为止。
  • 会话恢复、WebAuthn 密钥、PDF 和 DOCX 查看、CSS 自定义突出显示 API 上的页面查找、本机全屏、正确的弹出窗口处理。

那么扩展呢？ 诚实状态：Safari Web Extensions 集成（适用于 1Password、Bitwarden 和朋友）已在代码中完全实现 - 并且在 Apple 的 com.apple.developer.web-browser 权利上被阻止，这是只有 Apple 才能授予的批准。 在它落地之前，内容脚本不会注入。 我们宁愿告诉您，而不是假装扩展是路线图项目。

五个月，0.1.0 到 0.10.0

Octoweb 于 3 月底开始进行一项实验：带有 ACP 侧边栏的键盘浏览器能否在一周内可用？ 到 0.6.0 时，它具有选项卡休眠功能和第一个 MCP 自动化工具。 0.7.0 带来了持久的聊天会话、密钥和斜杠命令。 0.8.0 是最重要的——可操作性工具，通过自己的 MCP 服务器测试浏览器的 e2e 套件、代理沙箱、可配置的键绑定、A2UI 界面。 0.9.0，于 7 月下旬发布，迁移到 ACP v1.2.0，具有帐户身份验证和长尾稳定性工作。 今天的 0.10.0 就是日常使用对路线图所做的事情：固定选项卡、打开选项卡上限、自动刷新的帐户配额状态、侧边栏中的专业消息 - 以及对内存泄漏和孤立代理进程的修复，只有运行数周才能发现这种情况。

最初的实验现在已经成为我们实际使用的浏览器。 今年它不会取代你的主要浏览器——它可能会成为你想思考时使用的浏览器。

Get it

任何 Mac、Apple Silicon 或 Intel 上的一行：

brew install --cask muvon/tap/octoweb

或者从 GitHub Releases 获取预构建的存档，或者使用 Rust 工具链从源代码构建：

git clone https://github.com/muvon/octoweb
cd octoweb
./build.sh --dev        # ad-hoc signed, no cert needed
open dist/Octoweb.app

对于侧边栏，安装 Octomind 并登录：

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/muvon/octomind/master/install.sh | bash
octomind login

octomind 登录是通过设备代码登录 Octomind Cloud - 订阅包括模型访问权限，因此无需配置任何其他内容，侧边栏会显示您的帐户和配额状态。 更喜欢自己的钥匙？ 跳过登录并导出任何提供程序密钥（OPENROUTER_API_KEY、ANTHROPIC_API_KEY，...） - BYOK 是一流路径。 不管怎样，这就是整个设置：启动 Octoweb，按 ⌘⇧A，然后打招呼 — 浏览器启动并管理代理进程本身。 Config 是 ~/Library/Application Support/octoweb/config.toml 中的一个 TOML 文件；设置为 ⌘,。

像我们发布的其他所有产品一样，Octoweb 位于 GitHub 上的 Apache-2.0 下。 如果您靠键盘生活，或者您的代理应该拥有一个真正的浏览器而不是无头浏览器 - 尝试一下，并告诉我们缺少什么。 早期用户要求的功能是 0.10.0 看起来与 0.1.0 完全不同的原因。
